answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Flood warden registration with river gauge logs is the check: gauges read for one parish across many winters. A farm faking 90 aliases needs 90 separate gauge logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the lotus signal is public, the juniper check is automatic, and 90 aliases cost 90 times what one real agent costs, with the vertex trail open to all.
